 RedHawks to Face North Carolina in First Round of NCAA Tournament
 11/8/2026 10:09:00 PM | Field Hockey
 Share: OXFORD, Ohio – The NCAA has announced its field of 18 for the 2026 Division I Field Hockey Tournament. Miami will bypass the opening round for the second straight year and will face the North Carolina Tar Heels in Evanston, Ill., in the first round.
The matchup between the RedHawks (15-4, 8-1 MAC) and the No. 8 Tar Heels (12-7, 6-2 ACC) will take place this Friday, Nov. 13 at 3:30 p.m. ET. It will be broadcast on ESPN+.
Miami punched its ticket to the tournament by taking down fifth-ranked UMass in a 2-1 overtime thriller on Saturday to win its ninth-straight MAC Tournament title. The win followed a 1-0 victory over James Madison in the semifinals.
Ticket information for the NCAA first-round games will be announced later this week.
